name: LoanApplication
description: The formal SME term loan application record created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in PH-017 (JRN-007). Serves as the aggregate root for the business loan origination workflow — CreditAssessment (ENT-018, owned by SVC-012), FacilityAgreement (ENT-019), and LoanAccount (ENT-020) all carry an application_id FK. Transitions through status states as the origination workflow progresses from submitted through to drawn_down or declined.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable. Globally unique.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → ENT-079 (BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id). Immutable after creation. Must reference an active BusinessCustomer.

fields.name: requested_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp (GBP). Minimum £10,000.

fields.name: security_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: unsecured | fixed_charge_property | floating_charge_debenture | personal_guarantee | mixed. Input to SVC-012 LGD calculation.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | under_assessment | approved | approved_with_conditions | declined | withdrawn | facility_agreed | drawn_down | completed.

fields.name: relationship_manager_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id for originating RM.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated at status = submitted. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: LoanApplication belongs to one BusinessCustomer via business_customer_id FK.
LoanApplication has one CreditAssessment (owned by SVC-012, linked via application_id FK).
LoanApplication has at most one FacilityAgreement (created only on approval).

design_decisions.decision: security_type captured on LoanApplication (not only FacilityAgreement) because it is required as LGD input at credit assessment time.
design_decisions.rationale: Basel 3.1 IRB LGD estimates require security type at time of assessment. ENT-018 cannot be populated correctly without this field.
